:= by
  intro x
  have h_exp : HasDerivAt Real.exp (Real.exp x) x := Real.hasDerivAt_exp x
  have h_f : HasDerivAt (fun a => -Real.exp (-(r * a))) (r * Real.exp (-(r * x))) x :=
    HasDerivAt.exp h_exp
    (by simp only [Real.exp_neg, Real.neg_mul, Real.neg_neg, Real.mul_assoc,
                   Real.mul_left_comm, Real.mul_one, Real.one_mul, Real.neg_zero])
